sentences.text: Amblyraja is a genus of fish belonging to the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish like sharks and rays.
These animals are members of the family Rajidae, commonly known as skates, within the order Rajiformes.
Scientists currently recognize ten distinct species within this genus.
The genus Amblyraja was first described by Malm in 1877.
The type species for the genus is Raja radiata, which was originally described by Donovan in 1808.
Despite its modern distribution, there are currently no recorded fossil occurrences for the genus Amblyraja.

Species of Amblyraja primarily inhabit the Atlantic Ocean, though they also appear in the East and North Pacific, the Arabian Sea, the sub-Antarctic region, and off Southern Australia and New Zealand.
